title: Weekly runtime stitch — sync prep (Noor)
content:
Purpose: quick alignment for the week + concrete action items to unblock the console fallback work and one smaller perf experiment.

Meeting: weekly runtime stitch (30m) — standing time Tuesday 10:00–10:30 PT.
Attendees (invite list to confirm): Noor (host), Aisha, Mikael, Rhea, optional: Sam (infra), Ivy (sre).

Topline agenda (timeboxed)
- 00–03m: quick wins / shoutouts (2 bullets max)
- 03–10m: metrics snapshot & immediate alerts (p95, tail errors, cost delta)
- 10–22m: deep-dive: console fallback routing prototype (design + tradeoffs)
- 22–27m: quick unblock / support requests (who needs help this week)
- 27–30m: action items + parking lot + 1:1 follow-ups

Quick wins / shoutouts
- Aisha: lowered cold-start variance on small-model pool — nice drop in 95th for short seqs.
- Mikael: successful smoke of dedicated-burst config on qa-dedicated (no infra incidents).

Metrics snapshot (grab before sync: dashboard link in linked_artifacts)
- p50/p95 token-latency (all-hosted): 12ms / 110ms (yesterday) — trending +8% p95 vs last week.
- tail errors: 4 spikes in last 48h, root cause suspected: KV-cache eviction on L1 when sequence length changes rapidly.
- cost: small uptick from batching rarity for chat-long prompts; unit token cost +4% week-over-week.

Notes / hypotheses to call out
- Hypothesis A (KV-cache): rapid seq-length variance causes frequent cache flushes; affects throughput for L2+ models. Need an experiment to pin down eviction vs false positive invalidation.
- Hypothesis B (Batching): some routes are not falling back to size-optimized batching policy when sequence length exceeds threshold -> suboptimal utilization.

Deep-dive: console fallback routing prototype (10–12m discussion + 2m callouts)
- Current problem: console UI shows occasional "stuck" request state when runtime routes to cheaper variant; user sees spinner and manual retry.
- Prototype idea: add observable routing-trace for UI + graceful retry window (200ms) before immediate fallback.
- Tradeoffs: increases request latency for first attempt vs better UX; needs per-route SLO opt-in.
- Questions for team:
  - How do we instrument trace ID propagation in the console SDK without spamming logs?
  - Do we allow user-visible retry count? (UX implication)
  - Who owns the config surface for per-route SLO opt-in? (product + console + runtime ownership)

Quick unblocks / support asks (callouts ahead of meeting so people come prepared)
- Noor -> Sam: need small infra quota bump on qa-dedicated for running 2x fallback sims (JIRA INF-4821).
- Aisha -> SRE: can we get p95 breakdown by model family for last 72h to validate KV-cache hypothesis?
- Mikael -> Devtools: add a short-lived flag in console to enable routing-trace (behind feature flag).

Action items (capture in sync + ping owners after meeting)
- AI-1: (Noor) Draft a minimal tracing spec for routing-trace (one-pager) and post to Confluence; due 2026-03-16.
- AI-2: (Sam) Apply quota bump to qa-dedicated and confirm in #infra-results; due 2026-03-13. Linked: JIRA INF-4821.
- AI-3: (Aisha) Run KV-cache eviction experiment (A/B synthetic workload) and report metrics table (p50/p95/error-rate) by 2026-03-17.
- AI-4: (Mikael) Create console feature-flag PR that toggles routing-trace UI; include smoke tests; due 2026-03-15. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/912 (WIP).
- AI-5: (Rhea) Verify rollback plan for dedicated-burst config and add checklist to release notes; due 2026-03-14.

Parking lot (don’t burn sync time)
- Investigate long-tail cost when using quantized variants for long chat sessions — move to separate deep-dive next week.
- Discuss malling of model-version pinning semantics in Dedicated (ops/sales ask) — escalate if customer impact.

Prep items for me (Noor) before meeting
- Pull p95 heatmap by route and attach to agenda.
- Drop a one-paragraph forward note in the meeting invite with the two most important asks (quota bump + KV experiment).
- Flag the console-owners channel to ensure someone can speak to the UX tradeoffs.

1:1 follow-ups to schedule after sync (short list)
- Mikael: 15m to go over PR testing flakiness on CI (focus: smoke test infra).
- Aisha: 30m to review experiment design and ensure measurement consistency.
- Sam: 20m to confirm infra quotas and staging limitations for dedicated-burst tests.

Open questions to resolve in-thread or in meeting
- If routing-trace adds 10–20ms on first attempt, what is acceptable p95 regression for low-tier routes? (product needs to weigh).
- Should we expose retry behavior in the API/console or keep it internal?

Rough follow-up timeline after sync
- Within 48h: infra quota confirmation and tracing-spec sketch.
- Within 5 business days: experiment run + initial result deck.
- Next sync: Quick 5m recap on AI status; deep-dive if experiment inconclusive.

Notes-to-self (raw)
- Be crisp: prioritize the two asks, don’t let fallback UX dominate; if time, surface parking lot.
- Bring exact dashboard links; paste into Slack thread after meeting.
- If nobody can defend UX costs, push for a canary rollout model and short TTL on routing-trace.

End of scratchpad.

-- Noor
